# Hepatitis B evaluation for patients receiving Anti-CD20 Antibody Treatment

# NOTE: OUTPATIENT ORDERS

Before initiating anti-CD20 antibody treatment (rituximab, obinutuzumab,

ofatumumab) test all patients for Hepatitis B. Testing should be completed

within the last 6 months prior to the start of the initial infusion (same day

is acceptable, but not preferred). Annual Hepatitis B screening is not

necessary unless there are risk factors.

# More information at VHA Oncology SharePoint site for hepatitis B reactivation:

[Hepatitis B Oncology SharePoint](orz-gtx-abx-hepatitis-b-oncology-sharepoint)

# Order Hepatitis B Serology Panel for all patients:

[HEPATITIS B SEROLOGY PANEL](lrtz-hepatitis-b-serology-panel)

Includes hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), anti-hepatitis B core antibody

(total anti-HBcAb),and anti-hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBsAb).

# IF HBsAg or anti-HBcAb is positive, Consult GI for all services except

# Oncology:

(Includes Rheumatology, Renal, Neurology, and Dermatology)

[GASTROENTEROLOGY LIVER OUTPATIENT CONSULT](gmrctz-gastroenterology-liver-outpt)

# IF HBsAg or anti-HBcAB is positive for an ONCOLOGY patient initial orders:

a) Assess HIV status. To avoid potential HIV resistance-

refer HIV positive patients to ID for management.

[HIV RAPID TEST \(results in 1-2 hours\)](lrtzhiv-rapid-qualitative)

[CONSULT ID FOR HIV POSITIVE PATIENTS](gmrctz-infectious-disease-outpt)

b) Obtain Labs: Comprehensive Metabolic AND Phosphorus

[ORDER LABS: COMPREHENSIVE METABOLIC + PHOSPHORUS](orz-set-abx-lrtz-comprehensive-metabolic-mg-phosphorus)

c) Obtain HBV DNA level (viral load) initially

[HEPATITIS B DNA LEVEL \(VIRAL LOAD\)](lrtz-hepatitis-b-dna-level-viral-load)

d) Schedule GI Clinic Consult for co-management to order

liver imaging and follow-up as indicated.

[GASTROENTEROLOGY LIVER OUTPATIENT CONSULT](gmrctz-gastroenterology-liver-outpt)

e) Start hepatitis B antiviral treatment (see below)

# Recommended Antiviral Treatment:

Continue antivirals throughout anti-CD20 Ab therapy and for an additional

12 months to prevent hepatitis B reactivation, hepatitis, liver failure,

and death.

# Obtain HBV DNA level (viral load) every 3 months

[Hepatitis B DNA level \(viral load\)](lrtz-hepatitis-b-dna-level-viral-load)

# IF PATIENT IS CURRENTLY ON HEPATITIS B ANTIVIRAL THERAPY:

(lamivudine, adefovir, or telbivudine)

Consult the provider who ordered the antiviral and inform the

provider the patient is being initiated on Anti-CD20 antibody therapy.

# IF PATIENT IS NOT ON HEPATITIS B ANTIVIRAL THERAPY:

# Lamivudine-naive patients:

[Entecavir 0.5 mg po daily \(throughout anti-CD20 antibody therapy](psozid-entecavir-0-5mg-po-qday-hepatitis-b-anti-cd20-ab)

and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]

# Lamivudine-experienced patients:

# Preferred Treatment:

[Entecavir 1 mg po daily \(througout anti-CD20 antibody therapy](psozid-entecavir-1mg-po-qday-hepatitis-b-anti-cd20-ab)

and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]

< OR >

# Alternative Treatment:

IF creatinine clearance equal to or greater than 50 ml per minute

[Tenofovir 300 mg PO daily \(throughout anti-CD20 antibody therapy](psozid-tenofovir-300mg-po-qday-anti-cd20-therapy)

and for an additional 12 months after therapy completed). (Cost $$) [R,O]

References:

Terrault NA, Hepatology 2016, 63:261
